source: generated from the repository's web_mcp.tools(); the live server serves these after the next gateway restart

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Current price of a major cryptocurrency, gold or silver (Chainlink on Base), or an exchange rate between two currencies. Use for quick quotes of well-known assets; call list_price_symbols when unsure a symbol is covered. Free, no key needed.

kind.description: What kind of price to look up.

symbol.description: Ticker for crypto or metal, e.g. BTC, XAU.

base.description: Base currency for fx, e.g. USD.

quote.description: Quote currency for fx, e.g. EUR.

tools.title: Get price

tools.name: list_price_symbols
tools.description: Every crypto, metal and currency symbol get_price supports. Call it before get_price when unsure a symbol is covered. Free, no key needed.
tools.title: List price symbols

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: The AI models (chat, images or audio) available through SingIt, with their prices. Chat models can be called with chat or through SingIt's OpenAI-compatible API at https://app.singitai.app/v1. Free, no key needed.
tools.title: List models

tools.name: chat_free
tools.description: Free model answers, no key needed. Answers are short (400 tokens), with a small daily allowance shared per network and a shared daily budget that can run out. To pay for a model answer with your key use chat with the same model without the free/ prefix.

prompt.description: The question, as one user message. Send exactly one of prompt or messages.

messages.description: A whole conversation instead of prompt: text messages, oldest first.

model.description: A free model id such as deepseek-v4.1-flash; the free/ prefix is added if missing. Defaults to free/deepseek-v4.1-flash.

max_tokens.description: Longest answer, in tokens (1 to 400, default 400).

tools.title: Chat (free)

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Paid per call from your key's SingIt balance and limits in USDC. The server enforces per-request and daily caps; a call over a cap is refused before anything is charged. Use list_models for model ids and prices, get_limits for what remains, and get_receipts for the charge. Pass max_tokens high enough for reasoning models: thinking uses the same budget.

prompt.description: The question, as one user message. Send exactly one of prompt or messages.

messages.description: A whole conversation instead of prompt: text messages, oldest first.

model.description: A SingIt model id from list_models, without a free/ prefix. Omit it for SingIt's default model.

max_tokens.description: Longest answer, in tokens (1 to 8192, default 1024). Reasoning models think inside this budget, so leave room.

system.description: An optional system message; only together with prompt.

tools.title: Chat

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Your SingIt API balance: available and held USDC, auto top-up and pending top-ups. Use to check funds before paid calls. Free, but needs your API key.
tools.title: Get balance

tools.name: get_limits
tools.description: What your API key may still spend: its daily and per-request caps, spent and remaining today, scopes and expiry, plus your account's balance and, on Base, your allowance limiter (caps, left today, approved from your wallet, paused = emergency stop, expired). Read-only: it cannot change a limit. Use before a paid call to see whether it fits. Free, but needs your API key.
tools.title: Get limits

tools.name: get_receipts
tools.description: Your recent receipts, newest first: for each, its id, time, model, USDC charged, tokens and the upstream reference (kind charge, this key only), or the account's top-ups and refunds with their transaction and network. Read-only; page back with `before`. Free, but needs your API key.

limit.description: How many, newest first. Defaults to 10.

kind.description: charge (default): what this key spent; topup: money added to the account; refund.

before.description: Only entries older than this receipt id: pass the last id of the previous page.

tools.title: Get receipts

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Searches the web through Exa and returns titles, URLs and snippets of matching pages. Use for current or niche information, then read_page for a full page. Paid per call from your key's SingIt limits in USDC on Base or Solana; needs the key's "search" scope.

query.description: What to search the web for.

tools.title: Web search

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: The readable text of one web page (up to 8000 characters), through Exa. Use after web_search, or when you already have a URL. Paid per call from your key's SingIt limits in USDC on Base or Solana; needs the key's "search" scope.
tools.title: Read page

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: A sample weather forecast from GoPlausible's x402 demo service on Algorand. Takes no location and returns a fixed example, so it is mainly useful to try a paid call end to end. Paid per call from your key's SingIt limits in USDC; Base accounts only for now.
tools.title: Get weather

tools.name: get_singit_risk_check
tools.description: SingIt's risk check on Bankr x402 Cloud, run on a fixed sample payment request (no input). Mainly useful to try a paid call end to end. Paid per call from your key's SingIt limits in USDC; Base accounts only for now.
tools.title: SingIt risk check

tools.name: get_x_profile
tools.description: Public profile data for an X (Twitter) account by username, from twit.sh's x402 API. Use to check who is behind a handle. Paid per call from your key's SingIt limits in USDC; Base accounts only for now.
tools.title: Get X profile

tools.name: get_crypto_news
tools.description: Latest crypto market headlines with sentiment, from Otto AI. Use to see what is moving the market today; takes no input. Paid per call from your key's SingIt limits in USDC; Base accounts only for now.
tools.title: Get crypto news

tools.name: get_hyperliquid_market
tools.description: One Hyperliquid perpetual market (e.g. BTC): price, funding, open interest, max leverage and size rules, from Otto AI. Use for Hyperliquid's own contract details; use get_funding_rates to compare venues. Paid per call from your key's SingIt limits in USDC; Base accounts only for now.

asset.description: Perpetual market ticker, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL.

tools.title: Get Hyperliquid market

tools.name: get_funding_rates
tools.description: Funding rates for one symbol across exchanges, with open interest, long/short ratio, large positions and liquidations, from Otto AI. Use to compare venues or gauge positioning; use get_hyperliquid_market for one Hyperliquid contract. Paid per call from your key's SingIt limits in USDC; Base accounts only for now.

symbol.description: Market ticker, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL.

tools.title: Get funding rates

tools.name: resolve_ens
tools.description: Turns an ENS name (e.g. vitalik.eth) into its address, or an address into its primary ENS name. Paid per call from your key's SingIt limits in USDC; Base accounts only for now.
tools.title: Resolve ENS name

tools.name: get_token_price
tools.description: USD price of a major token by symbol from a paid x402 price API. get_price is free and covers the same majors, so prefer it; use this as a second source. Paid per call from your key's SingIt limits in USDC; Base accounts only for now.

symbol.description: Token ticker, e.g. ETH, BTC, SOL.

tools.title: Get token price
